intro_text: N: What do you sell here?
P: Hot dogs, chips, cookies, and soda.
N: Awesome. The only other place open this late sells vegan chicken sandwiches, so I'm so grateful you're here.
outro_text: N: This smells so good. Thank you.

intro_text: N: Just give me my food.
outro_text: N: You charge this much for this crap?

intro_text: N: Hi,
outro_text: N: Thanks.
P: You working as a security guard for the excavation site?
N: Yeah.
P: Must be a big project.
N: They found something revolutionary.
P: Really? What is it?
N: I keep asking, but they refuse to tell me.
N:
N: Anyway. Thanks for the meal. I gotta get back to work.

intro_text: N: Could I get...
outro_text: N: Smells great.

intro_text: N: Evening.
outro_text: P: *He's got an ID badge. Must be someone important.*
P: Working late?
N: Yeah. I'm working as a lab technician on-site.
P: How does it feel to be working on such a big project?
N: You know too?
N: ...Does anyone honor the non-disclosure agreement?
N: Well, it is an amazing discovery.
P: What kind of discovery?
N: The big kind. Like, changing our understanding of the universe big.
N: We dug up something that's still... alive.
P: ... what.
N: I know. I thought they were crazy when they called me in.
N: But, I've been examining samples of it...
N: And it's real. But they won't let me see it in person.
P: *And he says his coworkers are loose-lipped.*
P: They found something that's really alive?
N: Shoot. Look, don't tell anyone I told you that, alright? I gotta go. Thanks for the food.

intro_text: N: There's a lot going on around here.
outro_text: N: You're not safe.

intro_text: N: I haven't eaten at a food truck in years.
outro_text: N: So much nostalgia...

intro_text: N: Good evening! My name is Rody. I work with the local newspaper.
N: I've stumbled on something exciting, and I'd like to ask you a few questions about my discoveries.
N: I've been scouting the area, and..
P: Let me guess, is this about the excavation site?
N: How'd you know?
P: Rody, I'd love to chat, but I don't get paid by the hour. I get paid by the hot dog.
P: You plan to buy something?
N: Uhhh..
N: Anyway- That excavation site had an exciting discovery.
N: But they've been keeping it under wraps. They're acting like it's Area 51.
N: Do you think they found aliens?
N: Have you heard anything from the employees that come by for dinner?
P: I have, actually... One of the lab technicians told me they dug up a living creature.
N: A living creature?! Man, this is about to be the biggest scoop of my life!
N: I'm going to do some looking around the premises. I'll catch up with you tomorrow.
N: Oh, and could I also get a hot dog? Haha.
outro_text: N: Thanks!!
N: You shouldn't be here.

intro_text: N: Food.
N: Could I get a hot dog? I'm famished.
outro_text: N: Yum!
P: It's you again..
N: There's no turning back now.

day2.name: Lu
intro_text: N: Dude. You need to get out of here.
P: Yeah, I know. I've been trying. There's like nothing in this town.
N: No, I mean- whatever they dug up at the excavation site.. it's coming this way.
N: Actually, don't leave yet. You'll be safest in here. If you're outside and you see it, run. Just- run.
P: Did the thing they found escape??
N: Yes, and it's more horrifying than anything I've ever seen.
N: Look, I have to get back to my post. I'm safer in there than out here.
N: I just wanted to make sure you were alright. But...
N: I'll need one of those caffeinated sodas and a hot dog to keep me awake.
P: You sure the soda won't put you on edge?
N: I don't think I can get any more 'on-edge' than I already am.
P: Fair.
outro_text: N: *sigh* ...Maybe I should quit.
P: I wouldn't judge you if you did. In fact, I think it's a good idea..
N: Haha, you're probably right. But then I think about all the people who are still working at the excavation site who don't know any better...
P: You think it will come back for them?
N: Yes, I do. And some part of me is saying I need to be there for them.
N: Well... stay safe.
P: Thanks, I will.
